definition: y is an outside-closure discovery iff native_verifier(y)=ACCEPT, y notin Cl_G(x,B), and candidate and donor closure receive the same registered information x and budget B
non_rescue_constraints: old AND/OR ordering is not revisited
no larger donor budget assigned only after candidate success
next_freeze_requirements: choose >=3 domains with objective native verifiers
freeze complete closure checker or explicit CANNOT_CHECK condition
success_shape: verified nonempty outside-closure set in at least two materially different domains, with hostile controls showing the closure checker catches in-closure and budget-cheating candidates
failure_shape: no verified outside-closure discoveries under matched conditions; publish closure boundary rather than invent a new primitive after outcomes
